answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy uses a vertex interaction graph%3A each identity's cipher hashes its unique history. Forging identities means inventing a consistent fable of interactions%3B every fake vertex needs costly independent attestations from honest agents verifying the cipher on the ledger. An attacker spends computational and coordination resources scaling with fakes%2C as mismatches are rejected and stakes slashed%2C making mass fakes uneconomical.
